nodes.title: SG-4.1 · Extract asset preload module
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.preload (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts L45-L64) builds the fallback texture, registers a loaderror listener, calls planPreload and queues images and spritesheets inline. Desired behavior: a phaser/preload.ts module owns all of this and BootScene.preload only calls it. Expected result: same assets are loaded and the same fallback texture is used. Why: first step of splitting BootScene into thin lifecycle shell (SG-4).

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the scene and manifest, when preload runs, then phaser/preload.ts queues exactly the assets planPreload returns, using the typed manifest entries
- Given an unknown or failed asset id, when resolveKey is called, then the fallback texture key is returned
- BootScene.preload contains one call into phaser/preload.ts and no load.image, load.spritesheet or planPreload usage
- Given PNG assets, the existing bootScenePngPreload and bootScenePreload tests still pass


## Scope
- In scope: new game/frontend/src/phaser/preload.ts
- In scope: BootScene.preload delegation
- Out of scope: scene build, character animation, transitions extraction (SG-4.2, SG-4.3)
- Out of scope: game/src/engine changes
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0
- Preserve: player-visible behavior
- Preserve: FALLBACK_KEY export from BootScene
- Preserve: game/src never imports game/frontend


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- No test deleted or skipped; npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No source file over 200 lines
- Tests mock only what is external (Phaser, runtime content)


## Definition of done
- All requirements delivered and verified by unit tests
- npm test and npm run typecheck green in game/frontend


## Non-functional requirements
- No per-frame allocations; loaderror listener and fallback texture released on dispose


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · phaser/preload.ts queues planned assets from the typed manifest
nodes.body:
Context: queueing logic currently lives inline in BootScene.preload. Desired behavior: createPreloader in phaser/preload.ts calls planPreload(scene, manifest), warns for plan.unknown, and queues load.image or load.spritesheet with `assets/${entry.path}` and frame sizes. Expected result: identical load calls to today. Why: single-purpose module.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene referencing a known image id, when the preloader runs, then load.image is called with the id and assets/<path>
- Given a known spritesheet with frames, then load.spritesheet is called with frameWidth and frameHeight from the manifest
- Given an unknown ref, then console.warn is called with 'unknown asset ref: <id>' and nothing is loaded for it


## Scope
- In scope: queueing logic in preload.ts
- Out of scope: BootScene wiring
- Preserve: load paths and warning text


## Technical constraints
- Phaser ~3.90.0 pin
- No file over 200 lines
- Reuse planPreload from @game/engine/planPreload


## Dependencies
- I1


## Definition of done
- preload.ts queues same assets as old BootScene.preload


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Preload module owns the fallback texture, failed tracking and dispose
nodes.body:
Context: fallback texture generation, the failed Set and resolveKey are in BootScene. Desired behavior: the preloader generates FALLBACK_KEY texture, records loaderror keys, exposes resolveKey(id) and dispose() that removes the loaderror listener and fallback texture and clears failed ids. Expected result: unknown or failed ids resolve to FALLBACK_KEY. Why: SG-4 requires each module to return a dispose function.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an id unknown to the manifest, resolveKey returns FALLBACK_KEY
- Given a loaderror for a known id, resolveKey returns FALLBACK_KEY
- Given a known loaded id, resolveKey returns the id
- When dispose is called, load.off('loaderror') is called with the registered handler and the fallback texture is removed


## Scope
- In scope: fallback, failed set, resolveKey, dispose in preload.ts
- Out of scope: BootScene shutdown wiring beyond calling dispose
- Preserve: FALLBACK_KEY value 'fallback:missing' and checkerboard drawing


## Technical constraints
- Phaser ~3.90.0 pin
- Use resolveTextureKey from @game/engine/planPreload
- No file over 200 lines


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- preloader returns { resolveKey, dispose }


## Non-functional requirements
- Listeners and textures released on shutdown


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene.preload only calls the preload module and disposes it on shutdown
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.preload and resolveKey hold the logic. Desired behavior: BootScene.preload calls createPreloader(this, scene, manifest) and stores the handle; resolveKey delegates; SHUTDOWN handler calls dispose. FALLBACK_KEY stays exported from BootScene (re-export). Expected result: existing bootScene tests pass unchanged in behavior.

## Acceptance criteria
- BootScene.preload has a single createPreloader call and no load.image, load.spritesheet, planPreload or generateTexture
- BootScene.resolveKey returns the preloader result
- On SHUTDOWN the preloader dispose is called once
- FALLBACK_KEY is still importable from BootScene


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene.ts edits
- Out of scope: other BootScene responsibilities
- Preserve: resolveKey public method
- Preserve: create order and other shutdown cleanup


## Technical constraints
- Phaser ~3.90.0 pin
- BootScene under 200 lines
- No import from engine into frontend reversal: game/src never imports game/frontend


## Dependencies
- R2


## Definition of done
- BootScene.preload is a one-line delegation


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.description: Move FALLBACK_KEY, the generated 8x8 magenta checkerboard, the loaderror listener and resolveKey into createPreloader and return { resolveKey, dispose }.
acceptance_criteria: resolveKey returns FALLBACK_KEY for unknown or failed ids
dispose removes the loaderror listener and fallback texture
non_functional: Release listener and texture on dispose

steps.action: Export const FALLBACK_KEY = 'fallback:missing'. At the start of createPreloader, build the fallback texture using scene.make.graphics({x:0,y:0}, false): fillStyle(0xff00ff).fillRect(0,0,8,8).fillStyle(0x000000).fillRect(0,0,4,4).fillRect(4,4,4,4), generateTexture(FALLBACK_KEY,8,8), destroy (copy BootScene.ts L46-L50). Create const failed = new Set<string>() and const onError = (file: {key: string}) => failed.add(file.key); register with scene.load.on('loaderror', onError). Return resolveKey(id) => failed.has(id) ? FALLBACK_KEY : resolveTextureKey(id, manifest, FALLBACK_KEY), and dispose() { scene.load.off('loaderror', onError); failed.clear(); if (scene.textures.exists(FALLBACK_KEY)) scene.textures.remove(FALLBACK_KEY); }.
steps.expected: Preloader returns resolveKey and dispose; typecheck passes
